key_points: Truist initiated IBM with a Hold rating citing dividend and execution concerns and uncertain AI demand timing.
After-hours trading showed IBM wavering on a revenue miss and lowered 2026 outlook, though management said AI demand remains strong.
Several small institutional trades show mixed buying and selling, indicating no strong directional conviction.
Positive quantum news: DARPA selected IBM for independent quantum hardware testing and the company reached Stage C in quantum benchmarking.
Valuation commentary (Barron's) suggests IBM looks cheap, but Wall Street remains hesitant.
